Airlink Castle | Airlink Castle
Welcome to Hotel Airlink Castle!!
Hotel Airlink Castle is an exquisite Five Star Luxury Hotel, located at the portals of Cochin International Airport, Nedumabassery, Cochin and Kerala, India. Airlink Castle offers you 54 centrally air conditioned rooms with all modern facilities. All the rooms are designed for comfort with beautifully carved woodwork and furniture and a lookout to extensive coconut gardens. The multi-cuisine restaurants, 24 hour coffee shop, business room, health club, the activity center, board rooms, conference halls, rooftop swimming pool with a garden around, a premium bar well stocked with Scotch whiskies, French wines etc. will make your stay enjoyable and rejuvenating whether your stay is for business or leisure.
SPECIAL FEATURES
Multi Cuisine Restaurant Business Centre Banquet Facilities Board Room 24 hours Coffee Shop Conference Halls VIEW MORE
OUR FACILITIES
Hotel Airlink Castle signifes opulence, style, a pleasing ambience and environment, and a symphony of comfort. Hotel Airlink Castle welcomes all its guests for the serene accommodation in the hustle and bustle of Ernakulam. We provide high standards of facilities, accommodation and comfort to satisfy our most discerning guests. We are also reputed for our professional service, which is always accompanied by a warm and friendly smile.

pages.title: Airlink Castle | Airlink Castle
pages.text:
Airlink Castle | Airlink Castle
A welcoming experience designed to impress the most sophisticated traveller, Airlink Castle invites you to experience its unique hospitality standards and commitment to excellence in an exclusive and luxurious setting.
ACCOMMODATION
Well appointed air-conditioned rooms, a complete marvel in luxury and hospitality. The suites provide you with superior class facilities and 24-hours room service to make you feel privileged.
ROOMS & SUITES
Accommodation
The Hotel provides spacious and lavishly furnished rooms which are classified as Deluxe, Premium and PresidentialSuites.
Deluxe Twin Bed Room
Premium Bed Room
All the rooms are designed for comfort with elegant decor , equipped with a king size bed or twin bed,a working table, a cupboard/cabinet with safe locker, and LCD TV, telephone with direct dial facility, tea/coffee maker,mini bar,wi -fi,and 24 hour room service. The attached bathrooms are equipped with all modern amenities of toiletries with hot and cold water round the clock.
The differently - abled personsare allotted with rooms specially designed for them. We offer personalized attention with an eye for detail at all times.
Presidential-Suite-livinig-Room
Presidential Suite Bed Room
The Presidential Suite is a marvel of wood work. Tastefully designed for comfort, the traveller for leisure will find it a haven of tranquility for peaceful enjoyment. The Presidential Suites with luxuriously furnished living rooms are also ideal for guests wishing to conduct business in the privacy of a guest room.
